summary: Allen Parish lookout listed under the Louisiana Forestry Commission; Wikipedia says torn down and visible on aerial imagery until 2018. No build, staffing or fire record found.

facts.status_note: Wikipedia list says torn down and visible on aerial imagery until 2018; no removal date given

events.note: Wikipedia list says the tower was visible on aerial imagery until 2018

evidence.supports: agency is the Louisiana Forestry Commission
in 1915 funds for fire protection work allowed hiring lookout watchmen
evidence.quote: In 1915 funds were directed for fire protection work allowing the hiring of lookout watchmen or patrolmen.
By 1943 thirty-nine fire towers had been built and by 1950 the number had increased to fifty-six.

evidence.supports: first steel fire tower built near Bogalusa in 1922
evidence.quote: In 1922 the first steel fire tower was built near Bogalusa on Great Southern Lumber Company land.

evidence.supports: second tower built near Urania in 1923
evidence.quote: In 1923 the second tower was built near Urania

evidence.supports: before the first two towers, rungs were nailed to a pine tree with a perch near the top
evidence.quote: Prior to these two towers rungs were nailed to a pine tree with a perch erected near the top.

evidence.quote: Can be seen here on Google Street View.

sources.title: List of fire lookout towers in Louisiana

notes_for_editor: The Forest Lookouts page for Bel gives the parish and agency but no status line. Only the Wikipedia table gives a status. Two searches gave no build date, staffing or fire record. A bridge-inventory listing in search results names a 'Bel Fire Tower Rd' over Clear Creek in Allen Parish, which suggests a road still bears the tower's name; that page was not opened and is not used in the story. Brief coordinates match Wikipedia. Access is not recorded because no source says whether the site is public.
